sources.name: opencode
sources.list_query: SELECT id, title, directory AS cwd, time_updated FROM session_v2 ORDER BY time_updated DESC LIMIT :limit
sources.read_query: SELECT CASE WHEN type='user' THEN json_extract(data,'$.text') ELSE (SELECT group_concat(json_extract(value,'$.text'), char(10)) FROM json_each(session_message.data,'$.content') WHERE json_extract(value,'$.type') IN ('text','reasoning')) END AS text FROM session_message WHERE session_id = :id ORDER BY seq
